text: MPLS's original justification — faster lookup than longest-prefix match — evaporated. Why did it survive?
choices: Traffic engineering (paths can be placed with reserved bandwidth) and VPNs (stacked labels separate customers with overlapping private space)
explanation: MPLS is what happens when an industry that abandoned circuits discovers it wanted some of their properties after all. Fast reroute brings sub-50 ms protection to packet networks, closing the gap with SONET.
